scripts.build: bun run build:web && cargo build --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:release: bun run build:web && cargo build --release --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml
scripts.deploy:web: bun run build:web && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name oxiremote-web --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:landing: bun run build:landing && wrangler pages deploy apps/landing/dist --project-name oxiremote-landing --branch main --commit-dirty=true
